findings.text: blocking: the summarised observation path folds with elapsed_seconds=None and the re-rate at :4223 cannot restore a clock a dialect baked into its carry, so for the claude lane (_ClaudeDialect computes throughput at :2498 when the result event is folded) a stream whose result carries no duration_ms loses its wall rate — measured on one stream, base reports wall_tokens_per_second 33.33 at elapsed 12.0 and head reports null, which breaks the done_when's "each reader's answer equals its answer at the base revision" clause and contradicts the parity row the RCA claims.

non-blocking: the parity arm compares the second pass against _fresh, which runs the same three readers through the same summarised path, so both sides move together and the elapsed-clock regression above stays green; an independent arm would fold the whole stream through _backends.observe_stream with the tick's elapsed, which is what the done_when's base-revision clause asks.

non-blocking: _StreamScan is a second fold store beside _StreamFold at :3917 on the same summary, carrying its own copy of the extend-and-store loop at reckon/_backends.py:4128, so the next per-stream derived value has two precedents to follow instead of one generic fold keyed by name.

non-blocking: _STREAM_HEAD_SAMPLE drops from 8 KiB to 1 KiB, shrinking the only discriminator between an append and an in-place rewrite that preserves the opening, so a producer rewrite that keeps the first kilobyte but replaces later records is resumed as an append and the fold extends from records the stream no longer holds.

item_verdicts.goal: the goal is that the capacity check, the admission scan and observe_log read only the bytes a stream gained, and the diff does that — reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:1219 and reckon/crew/recovery_stream.py:828 fold through _backends.cached_stream_fold (reckon/_backends.py:4241) and _summarised_observation (reckon/_backends.py:4168) answers from the held fold, so the fixture's second pass reads 60,960 B against 85,307,840 B at base.
item_verdicts.manifest: read the source run's manifest.md; it states complete, names the four commits 5b784ef..02a13f1b92, the scoped gate at 62 passed, both suite arms (61 passed at 5b784ef, 62 passed at 02a13f1b92), both negative-control logs and the as_resume grep log, and it records no ruff result.
item_verdicts.write_paths: all seven changed paths — reckon/_backends.py, reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py, reckon/crew/recovery_stream.py, both test files, docs/research/monitor-storage-load-rca.html and the fragment — are inside the declared list, and the declared figure directory carries no figure at head.

justifications.durability: the byte bound at tests/test_no_steady_reader_reads_a_whole_stream.py:312 is proven to redden at base and the resumed-answer check at tests/test_watch_stream_parse_is_cached.py:252 is proven to redden on the reinstated one-record drop, but no assertion fails on the elapsed-clock regression the parity arm at :321 cannot see.
justifications.evidence: the byte measure is recorded and reproducible (85,307,840 B red at base, 60,960 B at head, logs/negative-control-base-revision.log), but the parity row at docs/research/monitor-storage-load-rca.html:625 is not what the gate measures, since tests/test_no_steady_reader_reads_a_whole_stream.py:321 compares head against head.
justifications.fit: cached_stream_fold and _StreamScan follow the module's existing cached_stream_* and per-stream summary idiom at reckon/_backends.py:4241, and no name the repository rules forbid is introduced.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/_backends.py:4241 holds each question as a fold the summary extends with gained bytes only, and a probe of one stream through reckon/crew/dispatch_sessions.py:1219 and reckon/crew/recovery_stream.py:828 returns the same capacity model and admission refusal as the base tree.
justifications.reuse: cached_stream_fold extends the per-stream summary owner rather than forking it, but _StreamFold's extend-and-store loop at reckon/_backends.py:4128 is copied for _StreamScan at :4121 instead of one generic fold owning both.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in 5b784ef..02a13f1b92 is one of the declared write paths, and no plan, state or unrelated module is touched.
